map.满减和折扣叠加？: Do threshold offers and percentage discounts stack?
map.常见先满减后打折，顺序不同到手价不同，须按活动规则确定。结果仅供电商运营测算、选: Usually the threshold offer applies first and then the percentage discount; a different order gives a different final price, so the campaign rules decide.
